Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full service-status payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Service status","overall":"degraded","headline":"We're aware of an issue affecting your area","area":"SoMa, San Francisco 94103","etaText":"Est. restore by 4:30 PM","updatedText":"Updated 2 min ago","services":[{"id":"internet","name":"Internet","status":"down","detail":"Fiber node offline","icon":"internet"},{"id":"tv","name":"TV","status":"degraded","detail":"Some channels affected","icon":"tv"},{"id":"mobile","name":"Mobile","status":"operational","icon":"mobile"},{"id":"voice","name":"Home phone","status":"operational","icon":"voice"}],"submitText":"Notify me when it's fixed","submitValue":"Please text me when service is restored"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Service status'. - 'overall' (string, optional): the summary banner state; one of 'operational','degraded','outage','maintenance'. If omitted it is derived automatically from the worst individual service. - 'headline' (string, optional): a short sentence under the banner label. - 'area' (string, optional): the affected location, e.g. a neighborhood + ZIP. - 'etaText' (string, optional): estimated restore time, e.g. 'Est. restore by 4:30 PM'. - 'updatedText' (string, optional): freshness stamp shown top-right, e.g. 'Updated 2 min ago'. - 'services' (array, REQUIRED, 1 to 6 objects): the services to show, top to bottom. Each MUST have 'name' (string). Optional per service: 'id' (string); 'status' (string; one of 'operational','degraded','down','maintenance'; defaults to 'operational'); 'detail' (string, one short line — defaults to the status label); 'icon' (string; one of 'internet','tv','mobile','voice','home' — picks the glyph; inferred from the name when omitted). - 'submitText' (string, optional): label for an optional action button, e.g. 'Notify me when it's fixed'. Omit to hide the button. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the exact message sent back to you when the button is tapped; defaults to 'submitText'. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
